title: confiture drift --format json
description: Schema drift report comparing the live database to expected DDL. Used by `confiture drift` (structural drift only). When `--check-acls` is also passed, ACL drift items are appended to the same `drift_items` array — see drift-check-acls.schema.json for the augmented contract.

constraints_checked.description: Constraints the DDL declares, plus each one the database has that the DDL does not (1.26.0, #507).

constraint_definitions_compared.description: Declared constraints paired with a live one whose definition (columns, referenced table and columns, actions, deferral, exclusion operators) was compared (1.26.0, #507). A CHECK is paired by name only, so it counts in `constraints_checked` and not here.

objects_checked.description: Views, materialized views, triggers and routines whose existence was compared (1.11.0, #303). Zero when the caller compared two schema models without their objects.

fidelity.description: How closely expressions were compared — CHECKs, index expression keys and predicates, view bodies. Present only when a scratch server built the tree and read it back (`materialised`: every expression compared as PostgreSQL stores it); absent at the command's default tier: `structural` where a database is a side (a default compared as a value, every other expression only as existing), `as_written` between two trees.

parser.description: What parsed the SQL behind this payload (0.50.0): the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. What the report found is in its own fields; a command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture` (`migrate up`, `lint`).
